title: Ewen was a fantastic...
text: Ewen was a fantastic guide - knowledgeable and witty. The areas we stopped were interesting and we learned a lot
author: Madison_C

title: Thank you very much Daniela for this fantastic experience
text: Fantastic experience, before arriving we didn't expect much given the such low price but it turned out to be one of the most interesting and fun experiences ever had, I can assure you since it is the third time I come to Barcelona and I have never had as much fun as this time during a tour, excellent guide, nice and manages to make you completely enter into what she is telling, not obvious truly exciting. Thank you very much to Daniela (our guide) because she was wonderful. Absolutely recommended experience
author: Freedom67462103242

title: Great alternative tour
text: We really enjoyed this tour. We learned so much and really felt that we had started to understand a whole new level of Barcelona and its (gruesome and bloody) complex history. Such a great twist to the traditional tour, we would definitely recommend.
author: Naomi_H

title: Do you believe in ghosts?
text: Met our guide Daniella at the Travellers Nest Bar in the Gothic Quarter.  We had a group of 6 which was the perfect size!  She shared lots of history plus some things you wouldn't hear from other tours.
author: Trish_K

title: Great tour
text: Had a great time on this tour. Ewan was very knowledgeable and gave a lot of interesting dark stories, more of a dark history tour than ghost stories. Highly recommend
author: melissabT4695HH

title: Barcelona ghost and history tour!
text: This is a really fun tour a little bit haunting and it's best to take one later in the evening. There's so much history to talk about and the tour guide, Ewan, was great in telling us about the history about the female seroconversion, the nuns and the children, and so much more about the history of Barcelona. And he let us through some really cool Backstreets and alleys that just added to the ambience.! take this to tour if you dare.
author: Angela_J

title: Fun and interesting and great to learn some history
text: To bring a fan if you are going in the summer months.  It’s very warm and it helps to get some air while waiting at some sites
